end.summary:
Practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism.
Discussed how cells and organs work together and affect the whole body.
Used human examples: muscle cell, muscle tissue, stomach, heart, blood vessels, and digestive/circulatory systems.
Used plant examples: leaf cell, leaf tissue, leaf, and xylem tissue; plant organ systems needed more practice.
Teach-back was not yet passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation with Yash using human and plant examples. They used the football-team idea to explain how cells or organs work together, and explained how blocked blood flow or stopped heart muscle activity can affect the whole body. Yash mixed up some plant organ-system examples and needed support with the complete order; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask them to make two labelled chains—one for a human and one for a plant—and say one example for each level.
